steps.content: The battle has ended, but the Rustfire combatant is still panicking. He frantically turns you this way and that, checking for injuries.
You feel the sincerity of his concern, but you're not used to this type of feeling.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please take care of yourselves first.
A few meters away, another faint figure appears. Hecate raises her hand to attack, but Raven stops her.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Don't do anything rash. It hasn't attacked you yet, and it might not attack at all. Look...
The apparition trembles a couple of times and trudges forward, lifting its arms wildly and swaying from side to side.
You quickly realize it's laughing with its friends.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: These aren't Corruptors. They're more like concretized spiritual contaminants—memories from this mine. In most cases, if you leave them alone, they'll just repeat the motions of their past lives.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Don't provoke them. Conserve your energy and keep going. It's actually quite entertaining to have them with us along the way.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Plus, if something does happen, your Chief will protect you. Right?
Hecate frowns upon hearing this. She slaps away Raven's hand from her shoulder and walks away without looking back.
The apparition raises its arm, as if calling out to someone. A couple of other apparitions come over, and together, they head away from you.
You can't hear their voices clearly, but it felt as if you're surrounded by laughter. These hazy "memories" make you feel warm and uplifted, but also a hint of sadness.
